package.description: Synology Note Station Client connects you with Note Station on your Synology NAS. You can manage all the notes/to-do list offline, right from your local computer.

en-US.description: Synology Note Station Client connects you with Note Station on your Synology NAS. You can manage all the notes/to-do list offline, right from your local computer.
en-US.longDescription:
Note Station helps you fully enjoy writing, viewing, managing, and sharing content-rich notes. It is very easy to create content with rich text editing, media embedding, attachments, and much more. Manage your notes by using tags and organizing notes into Notebooks. A version history of all your notes is automatically saved, making it very convenient to view and restore past versions.
Note Station is not just for personal use. When you are ready, Note Station makes sharing your content via social networking platforms simple and quick. In addition, other DSM users can collaborate with you in editing a shared note. Finally, Note Station is also available via DS note on Android and iOS. Create, share, and enjoy!
en-US.name: Synology Note Station Client

zh-CN.description: Synology Note Station Client 可帮助您连接 Synology NAS 上的 Note Station，并在本机电脑上离线管理所有的笔记/待办事项。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Note Station 能让您充分享受到写作、观看、管理和分享内容丰富的笔记之乐趣。您可以使用富文本编辑、媒体嵌入、附件等，来轻松创建内容。通过使用标签并将便签组织为记事本来管理便签。您所有便签的版本历史记录都会自动保存，从而方便查看和还原过去的版本。
Note Station 不只为个人使用。当您准备好后，Note Station 能够让您轻松快速通过社交网络平台分享内容。此外，其他 DSM 用户可以与您协作编辑共享便签。最后，Note Station 还可通过 Android 和 iOS 上的 DS note 获得。创造、分享和享受！
